description: Early Steps Academy offers the world's first and only live online case study classes for children ages 8-18. Built by alumni of Harvard Business School, it teaches 1000+ essential new-age subjects and skills through the case study method. The program uses a proprietary algorithmic classroom learning framework designed through deep research on learning outcomes. Students develop the 4C skills: Critical and Structured Thinking, Communication in English, Collaborative Attitude, and Creativity. 94% of parents say their child is more confident, 97% report improved grades, and 100% of children say Early Steps is the most fun place to learn. Mentors include Harvard Business School faculty and McKinsey consultants. Corporate partners include Bain & Company, Schlumberger, and Teach for India.
